title: "ANSI Colors Demo"
format: html
engine: markdown
term:
  shell: "zsh"
  prompt: "`\\$`"
  env:
    PS1: "$ "
---

## Basic Colors

The terminal renderer preserves ANSI color codes:

```{term}
printf '\033[31mRed text\033[0m\n'
printf '\033[32mGreen text\033[0m\n'
printf '\033[33mYellow text\033[0m\n'
printf '\033[34mBlue text\033[0m\n'
printf '\033[35mMagenta text\033[0m\n'
printf '\033[36mCyan text\033[0m\n'
```

## Bold and Styles

```{term}
printf '\033[1mBold\033[0m '
printf '\033[3mItalic\033[0m '
printf '\033[4mUnderline\033[0m '
printf '\033[9mStrikethrough\033[0m\n'
```

## Combined Colors and Styles

```{term}
printf '\033[1;31mBold Red\033[0m '
printf '\033[1;32mBold Green\033[0m '
printf '\033[1;34mBold Blue\033[0m\n'
```

## 256-Color Support

```{term}
for i in $(seq 0 7); do printf "\033[48;5;${i}m  "; done
printf '\033[0m\n'
for i in $(seq 8 15); do printf "\033[48;5;${i}m  "; done
printf '\033[0m\n'
```

## Background Colors

```{term}
printf '\033[41m Red BG \033[0m '
printf '\033[42m Green BG \033[0m '
printf '\033[44m Blue BG \033[0m\n'
```
